keySentence: Love made him real — love is the magic.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: He met real rabbits. They played together. Love is magic. Love made him real, love is the magic.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The real rabbit met other rabbits in the garden. They welcomed him and played together in the sunshine. Love made him real because love is the truest magic. He sometimes looked at the boy's window and smiled. The boy's love had given him the gift of life. True love can make the impossible become possible.
facts.Word cards: love = 사랑 / made = 만들었다 / real = 진짜의 / magic = 마법 / lesson = 교훈
